theme: A clear day to close the Florida logistics before the girls arrive.
greeting: You're back on the ground in St. Pete after the crossing home, Dan, with an open day before the girls come to you tomorrow at three. It's the right window to lock the last of the travel pieces while things are quiet.

needsAttention.title: The girls come to you tomorrow at 3
needsAttention.detail: Pickup is Tuesday at 3 PM, then straight to the Orlando villa for the week. The rental car and a grocery stop are the two open pieces worth settling tonight.

needsAttention.title: Florida rental still shows unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The p1 board item to book the full-size SUV out of TPA through Oct 5 — the one that seats all six — is overdue. Tomorrow's drive to Orlando needs it, so don't leave it to a walk-up rate.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are the last open item
needsAttention.detail: Six park tickets for Sat–Sun Sept 26–27 are still unbought. Check whether the type needs park reservations and whether Magic Kingdom has a Halloween-party night that weekend before you buy.

flagged.title: LinkedIn messages waiting
flagged.detail: Two messages in your LinkedIn inbox are flagged as awaiting a reply — worth a look given the search.

flagged.title: A sitter applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Lynsey P. applied to your childcare posting — relevant with the girls arriving tomorrow.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail promos, local newsletters, and a couple of order receipts.

recipe.title: Braised Pheasant with Mushrooms and Bacon
recipe.why: Autumn is game and wild-mushroom season, and a slow braise suits the first cool mornings.

First night in St. Pete after the flight back from Croatia — an early one earns tomorrow.
